name: penalty_crew_high_flag_heavy_underdog_opener
hypothesis: Home team's referee's prior-season mean_total penalty rate (existing referee_battery.md trait) in the top quartile AND home team getting >= 7 points at the OPENER line (heavy underdog) -- home cover rate vs. everyone else, graded at the Tuesday opener per AGENTS.md's binding 'grade the decision at the opener' rule. Mechanism: referee_battery.md cell 1's hypothesized road-team communication/tempo disruption from extra penalty stoppages is hypothesized to matter MOST when the home team is already a big underdog and most needs the extra time stoppages buy to control tempo/limit possessions against a stronger opponent, so the home-cover edge should concentrate in this subset. No new trait -- reuses the existing mean_total trait, only narrows the population. Cell A of the predeclared penalty-type-crew-tendency family (docs/data_source_scout_v4.md lead #1). Predeclared docs/penalty_crew_tendencies.md BEFORE any effect on this population was computed; recorded regardless of sign.

reliability_check.reason: Reuses referee_battery.md cell 1/2's existing mean_total trait unchanged: MEASURED year-over-year Pearson r = +0.370, 158 referee-season pairs -- a real, moderate persistent trait.
